✅ Step 1 — Enable storage access in Termux
Run this in Termux:
shCopy codetermux-setup-storage

You’ll get a popup asking for permission → Allow.
This creates:

/storage/emulated/0/ symlink

~/storage/shared/

~/storage/downloads/

~/storage/documents/

~/storage/dcim/

Without this, any access to /storage/emulated/"
